'''TL-017''' was a [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commando]] stationed in [[Bestine Capitol Building|Bestine Capitol]] building during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
TL-017 is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. He was added to the game when the developers implemented the Bestine election system in [[2004]]. He serves no purpose in the game, other than to simply speak to players who converse with him.
